code: Metro m = new Metro(); m.connect("ETH", "Central"); m.connect("Bahnhof", "Central"); m.connect("Central", "Bellevue"); m.connect("Central", "ETH"); return m.neighbours("Central") + " " + m.neighbours("ETH");

name: errors
